_source: France, mainland, 13 game regions (INSEE regions of 2016 = NUTS 1, so the Eurostat NUTS 2 parts are summed). upper_secondary_school: units = the lycees that report pupils in rentree 2024, capacity = their ENROLLED pupils, NOT places (no body publishes places): Ministere de l'Education nationale, open data portal data.education.gouv.fr, datasets fr-en-lycee_gt-effectifs-niveau-sexe-lv and fr-en-lycee_pro-effectifs-niveau-sexe-lv, field nombre_d_eleves summed over the two datasets per lycee (numero_lycee, the UAI), region = code_region_insee, public and private under contract; agricultural lycees (Ministry of Agriculture) are not in these datasets. Overseas regions (INSEE 01 to 06) and the 74 lycee rows carrying region code 00 (the overseas collectivities and territories: UAI prefixes 971, 975, 983, 984, 987) are left out. pupils_per_teacher: those pupils over the full-time-equivalent teachers (etp_enseignants_hommes_et_femmes) of the same lycees, dataset fr-en-indicateurs_personnels_etablissements2d rentree 2024 joined on the UAI; 31 mainland lycees (11 with no teacher row, 20 with a zero or null FTE; Ile-de-France: 1 and 6) are left out of the level only, not out of the stock. Scope, not corrected: that FTE counts every teacher of the establishment, including those of the post-baccalaureate sections some lycees host (BTS, CPGE), while the pupils are the seconde, premiere, terminale and CAP/bac pro years only and the datasets give no teacher split by level; the mainland ratio (10.18) therefore sits below Eurostat's upper-secondary figure (11.5). The level is read only as each region's own value around the nation's, which the loader normalises, so the offset is not carried in the game. hospital: units = establishments of health (a Finess geographic entity holding at least one care authorisation, public and private, all activities) per region in 2021, DREES, Base ARES, 'Nombre d'etablissements de sante en France 2013-2021', sheet NB_ET (published 2023-02-06; DREES, SAE); capacity = available hospital beds in 2021, Eurostat hlth_rs_bdsrg2 (unit NR), NUTS 2 regions summed to the game regions. beds_per_1000 = those beds over the region's population on 1 January 2021, Eurostat demo_r_d2jan (sex T, age TOTAL). Self-checks: the 13 regions' beds plus the five overseas regions' (9 167) equal the Eurostat national 380 607; the regions' establishments (2 905) plus overseas (86) equal DREES's 2 991. Licences: Licence Ouverte 2.0 (Etalab) for the French portals, Eurostat's re-use policy. Read 2026-11-17. A level is the region's own value in the figure's unit; the loader normalises it.
